_doc: Per-network deploy parameters for the StableNaira CCTP-style stack. Each chain deploys: StableNaira (UUPS proxy + impl + factory), ValidatorRegistry (UUPS), MultisigVerifier (non-upgradeable), MessageTransmitter (UUPS), TokenMessenger (UUPS). BSC chains additionally deploy StableNairaPriceOracle. Domain ids are application-defined uint32 identifiers stamped into every cross-chain message; they MUST match across chains and never collide. Timelock 0 means 'use the contract floor (1h)'. Initial validators / threshold are passed at init and bypass the timelock; everything else (route wiring, validator changes after init, verifier swap) goes through the queue/commit gate.
_admin_history: Rotation log (most recent last). 1) Testnet rollout 2026-05-04: admin/owner/validators/reporters seeded with 0x39e67B9238B874f74233692454E2D04E9fC68363 (testnet deployer). 2) First mainnet rollout 2026-05-05: rotated to mainnet deployer 0xDe-E6-10-DE-Dc-65-2a-a0-A8-EB-9d-70-EB-41-5d-94-00-fC-F3-87 (hyphens added so audit-trail entries survive bulk replace_all edits to this template). The live mainnet contracts on BSC, Ethereum, and Base were initialized with that 0xDeE6 address as their on-chain owner. 3) Mainnet re-prep 2026-05-05: rotated forward to 0x39e67B9238B874f74233692454E2D04E9fC68363 in preparation for a fresh mainnet redeploy under that key. The 0xDeE6 contracts remain immutable on chain until ownership is transferred or a new deployment supersedes them. Single-key deployer-as-owner posture continues to override the published Mainnet Hard Gates; multisig migration is the next operational priority.
